criteria.keep: MY Agent owns the product contract. Do not overwrite identity, company model matrix, install/first-run UX, public exe/update entry, or the settings/model center. CQR_PA is a frozen archive, not the live product.
criteria.apply: Copy from CQR_PA only when the file is shared engine (agent loop, tools, security, routes) and this repo does not own the product contract for that path.
criteria.org: Organization/brand/automaton files never land in this repo. Those go to myagent-org (apply_org).
criteria.when_unsure: Keep local. Add a keep rule with a reason. Do not expand EXTRA to UI or install files.

keep.reason: This repo's name, version, GitHub target, and public docs.
The keep policy itself must not be replaced by the archive copier.
MY Agent model SKUs, provider defaults, and generated facts. Archive still has terra/pro and CQR labels.
Install checklist and first-run optional downloads. Archive install UI has no picker and force-downloads extras.
MYAgent.exe, bin/my-agent, desktop shortcut, and update channels. Archive still ships cqr-pa paths.
Settings and model center already rebuilt for MY Agent. Archive EXTRA used to copy old Settings pages over them.
Verify scripts that enforce the keep rules. If the archive overwrites them, the next port is unguarded.
